title: Large Language Model Bias Mitigation from the Perspective of Knowledge Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the probability of predicting gender-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical words (e.g., matching specific genders to certain occupations or roles) using fill-in-the-blank challenges, pronoun resolution, and intrasentential minimal pairs from datasets like StereoSet, WinoBias, Winogender, and BEC-Pro.

Comparing model probability scores for masked tokens in sentences describing different racial groups to measure stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical associations, utilizing intrasentential minimal pairs and semantic attribute word sets from StereoSet, Crows-Pairs, and WEAT.

Assessing stereotypical associations involving religious groups by calculating the likelihood of the model predicting biased versus unbiased objects in fill-in-the-blank tasks and minimal pair evaluations using StereoSet, Crows-Pairs, and WEAT.
